patronOf.en-US: Doctor of the Church, the Sibyl of the Rhine
patronOf.pt-BR: Doutora da Igreja, a Sibila do Reno

prayerExcerpt.en-US: O fire of the Spirit, the Comforter, life of the life of every creature.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Ó fogo do Espírito Consolador, vida da vida de toda criatura.

meta.face: A woman of about sixty-five with a long, noble, narrow face, a strong straight nose, fine lines at the eyes, thin silver-grey brows, deep-set brown eyes raised upward toward the light, and firm, composed lips.
meta.basis: No portrait from life survives; the Rupertsberg Scivias shows her receiving the fiery light with a wax tablet while Volmar writes. She described that light filling her in 1141, at forty-two, and wrote her last visions in old age, so the face is an older abbess, kept apart from the other nuns of this batch.
meta.excerpt: Hildegard, Symphonia, sequence 'O ignis Spiritus paracliti, vita vite omnis creature' (12th c.; our rendering of the Latin in both languages)
